author: games_agency
quote: This game should have been released on PC rather than consoles, because its performance on consoles is absolutely terrible. I don't understand why the company refuses to release this game on PC. This game requires powerful hardware, while consoles are already outdated. The latest PlayStation and Xbox consoles were released in 2020, and their hardware simply isn't powerful enough to run this game properly. It's really disappointing that a game like this is a console exclusive. It's extremely frustrating.
